## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the hash identifying a [`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md) on its chain — the content-addressed identity that anchors the block independent of its sequential number.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a transaction's hash ([`gmeow:transactionHash`](gmeow-transactionHash.md)) or the block's ordinal position ([`gmeow:blockNumber`](gmeow-blockNumber.md)); the block hash is the block's cryptographic identity, not a transaction or an index. Functional — one hash per block.

### How to use

- Set one block-hash literal on the [`gmeow:Block`](../classes/gmeow-Block.md) alongside [`gmeow:blockNumber`](gmeow-blockNumber.md); transactions reference the block so their inclusion can be checked against both.

### Examples

- ex:block42 [`gmeow:blockHash`](gmeow-blockHash.md) "0xdef456...".
